verdict.rationale: Gazebo Sim's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (gazebosim/gz-sim), where the repository directory listing is visible, and the docs mention switching to a source-based install. So the source is readable, but nothing in the pack states which license governs it, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence (e.g., an Apache/BSD/MIT LICENSE file or license statement), independent corroboration of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
